description: Flags grammatically correct English that no native speaker would say — and teaches the natural version.
notes: Pattern engine is rule-based over ~30 hand-built patterns; not a full NLP model.
Built against the shared Kit contract (window.Kit); a minimal inline shim is retained as fallback if shared/kit.js is ever absent.

notes.note: 'Correct but foreign' is a real plateau, but every general LLM now gives pattern-level collocation feedback for free — including inside Duolingo Max. $7/mo for what ChatGPT does in a good prompt is a brutal competitive position. The B2B ESL-school tier is the only defensible inch.
